_note: Licence allow-list used by scripts/credits.js and scripts/validate-schema.js. A licence that is not listed here is rejected: unclear means no. Terms change; re-read the source page on the day of use and record that date [CHECK]. This file is not legal advice.

Public-Domain.name: Public domain (stated by the source)
Public-Domain.note: Record who says so and where. Public domain in one country is not public domain everywhere [CHECK].

CC-BY-4.0.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
CC-BY-4.0.note: Attribution text must appear in the credits.

CC-BY-3.0.name: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0
CC-BY-3.0.note: Attribution text must appear in the credits.

OFL-1.1.name: SIL Open Font License 1.1
OFL-1.1.note: Fonts. Covers every family loaded through @remotion/google-fonts that Google lists as OFL [CHECK per family].

MIT.name: MIT License
MIT.note: Code and some icon sets; keep the notice with redistributed source.

Pexels.name: Pexels License
Pexels.note: No identifiable people in a bad light, no reselling unaltered [CHECK current terms].

Pixabay.name: Pixabay Content License
Pixabay.note: [CHECK current terms]; some items carry extra restrictions.

Own-work.name: Made by the user or drawn in code by this skill
Own-work.note: Code-drawn characters, props and effects need no entry; use this only for files the user supplies and says they own.

Google-Fonts.name: Google Fonts catalogue (OFL 1.1, Apache 2.0 or Ubuntu Font Licence, per family)
Google-Fonts.note: Only for families loaded through @remotion/google-fonts. [CHECK] the licence tab of the family before publishing.

Gemini-API-Output.name: Google Gemini API generated output
Gemini-API-Output.note: Speech made with the user's own Gemini API key (scripts/generate-voiceover.js). The Gemini API Additional Terms say Google does not claim ownership of generated content [CHECK current terms before commercial publishing].

always_reject: CC-BY-ND (any version): no derivatives, and a film is a derivative
CC-BY-SA: share-alike would bind the whole film; reject unless the user accepts that in writing
Rights-managed or royalty-free stock that needs a paid account
Anything scraped from a search engine, social post or video with no licence statement
AI-generated media from a service whose terms the user has not read
trademark_flag_when: A logo, wordmark, product shot or UI screenshot of a real company
A character, sprite or trade dress from an existing film, game or comic
A brand name used as more than plain text in narration
trademark_rule: Flagged items are not rejected automatically. They are recorded with trademark_sensitive: true and the user must approve each one before render. Plain-text mention of a company in a factual script is normal; drawing its logo is not.
